newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam's Jan-Nov 15 trade gap widens to $3.59 bln.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam's Jan-Nov 15 trade gap widens to $3.59 bln.

text.p: Vietnam posted a record trade deficit of $3.591 billion in the period from January 1 to November 15, the Government Statistics Office said on Wednesday.
The latest figures showed the cumulative deficit widening from $3.35 billion in the first 9-1/2 months of the year.
The statistics office, which does not report trade data on a regular basis, gave no comparative figures for corresponding periods in 1995. The trade gap for the whole of 1995 was $2.3 billion.
Exports for the period from the beginning of this year until mid-November were $6.193 billion and imports were $9.784 billion.
